title: Titus 1: chapter overview
paragraphs: The qualifications of a faithful pastor.
The evil temper and practices of false teachers.

outline.text: The qualifications of a faithful pastor.
The evil temper and practices of false teachers.

context: This epistle chiefly contains directions to Titus concerning the elders of the Church, and the manner in which he should give instruction; and the latter part tells him to urge obedience to magistrates, to enforce good works, avoid foolish questions, and shun heresies.
attribution: Matthew Henry, Concise Commentary (public domain). Historical Protestant interpretation; other traditions may read these passages differently.

title: Titus 2: chapter overview
paragraphs: The duties which become sound doctrine.
All is enforced from the holy design of the gospel, which concerns all believers.

title: Titus 3: chapter overview
paragraphs: Obedience to magistrates, and becoming behaviour towards all, are enforced from what believers were before conversion, and what they are made, through Christ.
Good works to be done, and useless disputes avoided.
